Fear, anger, adrenaline, trust is an intensive, 3-hour online workshop exploring the powerful emotional terrain of psychological edge play in kink. This class invites participants to delve into the complex — and potentially transformative — practice of incorporating emotions like fear and anger into consensual BDSM dynamics. 
Through guided discussion, self-reflection, and partnered conversations, we’ll explore how to cultivate trust and control in order to intentionally let go of it, unlocking catharsis, intensity, and connection. Led with a trauma-aware, consent-centered approach, this class centers communication, ethical negotiation, personal responsibility, and self-awareness as core components of advanced play.

A basic framework of psychological edge play
Risk assessment and management for emotional sessions
Planning and negotiating scenes, including aftercare

Kink practitioners curious about incorporating emotional intensity and adrenaline into their play
People with experience in BDSM who want to explore fear, anger, or surrender safely
Anyone seeking ritualistic and/or spiritual meaning or emotional catharsis through kink

events.title: Ignore The Machine (hanno leichtmann / nils ostendorf)
events.description:
A new duo from Berlin. By and featuring Hanno Leichtmann and Nils Ostendorf. Both are seasoned musicians with eventful careers who operate within very different artistic spheres.

One of them, Hanno Leichtmann, is a veteran—and remains to this day a pioneer—of the electronic music scene that has developed in Germany’s capital since the years following the fall of the Berlin Wall, thanks to projects such as Static, the Trio Groupshow, and countless collaborations.

The other, Nils Ostendorf, plays a trumpet whose capabilities are expanded through the use of various devices. He comes more from the world of contemporary jazz and has been a sought-after musician and composer on theater stages for years.

Hanno Leichtmann and Nils Ostendorf both use—at different times of the day, in rapid succession—a recording studio in the Wedding district filled with hand-picked instruments and equipment.

When the two met at the same time in that studio in May 2026, the plan was actually just to record a series of tracks for a release by Chromacolor, another solo project by Hanno Leichtmann.

It all went faster than planned. In the end, they still had some studio time together. The result was a completely unplanned, 60-minute-long improvisation. All recorded in real time.  The six tracks featured here were created through precise and decisive edits to the improvised and recorded material. Without any overdubs added afterward.  The result is music that is open, exploratory, and not bound exclusively to any one genre. It has no qualms about engaging with the world of tonality and musical figuration. The boundaries and overlaps between ambient and jazz, free improvisation and musique concrète are blurred and constantly renegotiated. 

All the semantics and moods found here are, in principle, unstable. Every state reached is transitory. One thing leads to another. We perceive and imagine spaces of possibility that are becoming increasingly rare in the material world.  Ignore The Machine’s debut is the first release on Hanno Leichtmann’s new label, Semen Contra. It is available exclusively as a limited-edition CD. Each release includes an art print from the label head’s extensive image library.

events.title: CHRIS BENNETT – «ONCE UPON A TIME» – SPECIAL GUEST: RICK ROSS
events.description: CHRIS BENNETT «ONCE UPON A TIME» SPECIAL GUEST: RICK ROSS FEAT: ERIC UNSWORTH-HEINRICH KÖBBERLING DEUTSCH Chris Bennett begann ihre Laufbahn in Deutschland, als Lead-Sängerin von Munich Machine, der wohl erfolgreichsten Discogruppe des Produzenten Giorgio Moroder. Sie schrieb Musik für Tina Turner, The Manhattan Transfer und Randy Hall, und produzierte Keb Mo’s erste CD «Rainmaker». Seit mehr als 30 Jahren ist sie mit ihrer Band regelmäßig zu Gast im A-Trane und nahm dort 1999 ihre CD „Live in Berlin“ auf. Vier Jahre später, im Oktober 2003, folgte die zweite CD „Once Upon A Time“ Live at the A-Trane , aufgenommen während einem Gastspiel im A-Trane. Auch dieses Mal hat sie den langen Weg von Los Angeles nach Berlin nicht gescheut und bringt diesmal den Saxophonisten Rick Ross aus LA mit. Rick Ross ist ein dynamischer Multiinstrumentalist und Sänger aus Südkalifornien, der für seine gefühlvollen Darbietungen auf dem Klavier und dem Saxophon sowie für seine volle, fesselnde Stimme bekannt ist. Ursprünglich aus Indianapolis stammend, hat Rick Ross einen einzigartigen Musikstil kultiviert, der klassische Raffinesse mit zeitgenössischem Flair verbindet. Was für jede Jazzvokalistin schon ein Lob darstellen würde, bedeutet für Chris Bennett noch ein weiteres: die Anerkennung ihrer Eigenständigkeit als Interpretin und Entertainerin. Die großen Gesten sind dabei ihre Sache nicht – dieser Sängerin muss man schon aufmerksam zuhören, sie drängt sich einem nicht auf. Dass Chris Bennett jedoch die Bühne als ihren angestammten Raum betrachtet, schlägt sich auch in ihrer Diskographie nieder: bei zwei ihrer insgesamt sechs Jazzalben handelt es sich um pure Konzertmitschnitte – eindeutiges Zeichen dafür, dass die Künstlerin sich ihrer Live-Qualitäten sicher ist. Und auch ihres Publikums: „ Please welcome Chris Bennett! “ ENGLISH Chris Bennett began her career in Germany, as lead singer of Munich Machine, arguably producer Giorgio Moroder’s most successful disco group. She wrote music for Tina Turner, The Manhattan Transfer and Randy Hall, and produced Keb Mo’s first CD „Rainmaker“. She has been a regular guest at the A-Trane with her band for more than 30 years and recorded her CD „Live in Berlin“ there in 1999. Four years later, in October 2003, the second CD „Once Upon A Time“ Live at the A-Trane followed, recorded during a guest performance at the A-Trane. This time, too, she didn’t shy away from the long journey from Los Angeles to Berlin, this time bringing along saxophonist Rick Ross from LA. Rick Ross is a dynamic multi-instrumentalist and vocalist based in Southern California, known for his soulful performances on piano and saxophone, as well as his rich, captivating voice. Originally from Indianapolis, Rick has cultivated a unique musical style that blends classic sophistication with contemporary flair. What would be praise enough for any jazz vocalist, means yet another for Chris Bennett: recognition of her independence as a performer and entertainer. The big gestures are not her thing – you have to listen carefully to this singer; she doesn’t force herself on you. However, the fact that Chris Bennett regards the stage as her ancestral space is also reflected in her discography: two of her six jazz albums are pure concert recordings – a clear sign that the artist is confident of her live qualities. events.title: PETER GALL // SOLO SHOW
events.description:
PETER GALL // SOLO SHOW
solo drums, beats, synth scapes plus material from the brand new album DRUM SEEDS

"Many of today’s jazz drummers are somehow different – ideally like Peter Gall," says Germany’s largest jazz magazine, Jazzthing.

Berlin-based drummer, composer, and producer Peter Gall is widely regarded as one of the leading German jazz drummers of his generation.

After studying jazz drums in Berlin and New York, he has performed with internationally acclaimed artists and ensembles across Europe and beyond. As an in-demand studio musician, Peter has contributed to more than 50 albums, working across jazz, pop, and indie music. He also serves as Professor of Jazz Drums at the Mannheim University of Music and Performing Arts.

His latest album, LOVE AVATAR, was awarded the German Jazz Prize 2025 for ALBUM OF THE YEAR.
There’s already a lot of buzz surrounding his brand-new album DRUM SEEDS, which puts the drums and original beats in the spotlight. But that’s only how it seems at first glance. Peter Gall’s new solo album is much more than just a drum statement.

In his solo show, he presents solo drums and improvisation, with a strong focus on irresistible grooves and trippy beats with a highly emotional and human pulse, alongside material from his latest release DRUM SEEDS (+ very new stuff). Although this is a one-man show with the drums at its center, it also features song-like structures with deep harmonies, catchy melodies and hooklines, and sometimes even orchestral soundscapes that open up new worlds, paired with a great deal of melancholy.

Come out and be surprised!

Seit 2018 stehen Gitarrist Alexander Rueß und Sänger Atrin Madani regelmäßig gemeinsam auf der Bühne – für diesen Abend im A-Trane haben sie ausgesucht, was ihnen selbst am meisten bedeutet: Songs von Pat Metheny und Gordon Lightfoot, dazu Originals aus ihrem gemeinsamen Programm. events.title: Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq – «Journey To The Source»
events.description: Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq « Journey To The Source » FEAT : Rolf Zielke-Maximilian Hughes-Kenny Martin English : This evening’s performance promises a journey through original compositions and inspired improvisations—music that reaches backward into tradition while stretching forward into the unknown. A living conversation: A searching spirit. A source still flowing. For over three decades, Journey To The Source (formally Fuasi and Ensemble) has been carving out its own unmistakable path through the European jazz landscape. Founded in 1995 by Berlin-based saxophonist, composer, and bandleader Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq, this enduring quartet has performed across Germany, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, Portugal, and France, building a reputation for music that is both deeply rooted and fearlessly exploratory. Their sound is immediately recognizable—an organic blend of Blues, Hard Bop, African and Far Eastern influences, spiritual undertones, funk grooves, and the open language of modern improvisation. What emerges is music of soul and substance: rhythmically alive, emotionally rich, and charged with the spirit of collective storytelling. At the center of the ensemble stands Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq , recently honored with the prestigious Deutscher Jazzpreis (Live Act of the Year 2026)— one of Germany’s highest recognitions in jazz . This award reflects not only his decades-long artistic vision, but also the profound contribution he and his ensembles have made to the Berlin jazz community and the wider German jazz scene. Over the years, Journey To The Source has released several acclaimed recordings, including Fuasi & Ensemble, Fuasimodo Rings a Bell, Live at Café Central (Madrid), The Afro-Cubano Latin Jazz Connection, The Abakua, and their latest self-titled studio release, Journey To The Source. Deutsch : Der heutige Abend verspricht eine Reise durch Eigenkompositionen und soulful Improvisationen – Musik, die in die Tradition zurückgreift und zugleich in das Unbekannte weist. Ein lebendiger Dialog: Ein suchender Sinn .Eine Quelle, die noch immer fließt. Seit über drei Jahrzehnten beschreitet Journey To The Source seinen ganz eigenen, unverwechselbaren Weg durch die europäische Jazzlandschaft. Gegründet 1995 vom in Berlin lebenden Saxophonisten, Komponisten und Bandleader Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq, hat das Quartett in Deutschland, Polen, Spanien, der Schweiz, Portugal und Frankreich konzertiert und sich dabei einen Ruf für Musik erarbeitet, die zugleich tief verwurzelt und furchtlos suchend ist. Ihr Klang ist vom ersten Ton an erkennbar – eine organische Verbindung aus Blues, Hard Bop, afrikanischen und fernöstlichen Einflüssen, spirituellen Klangwelten, Funk-Grooves und der offenen Sprache moderner Improvisation. Daraus entsteht eine Musik voller Seele und Substanz: rhythmisch lebendig, emotional vielschichtig und getragen vom Geist des kollektiven Erzählens. Im Zentrum des Ensembles steht Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq , der kürzlich mit dem renommierten Deutschen Jazzpreis 2026 in der Kategorie „Live Act of the Year“ ausgezeichnet wurde – einer der höchsten Ehrungen im deutschen Jazz . Diese Auszeichnung würdigt nicht nur seine jahrzehntelange künstlerische Vision, sondern auch den nachhaltigen Beitrag, den er und seine Ensembles zur Berliner Jazzszene und darüber hinaus zur deutschen Jazzlandschaft geleistet haben. Im Laufe der Jahre hat Journey To The Source mehrere vielbeachtete Aufnahmen veröffentlicht, darunter Fuasi & Ensemble, Fuasimodo Rings a Bell, Live at Café Central (Madrid), The Afro-Cubano Latin Jazz Connection, The Abakuá sowie zuletzt das aktuelle, selbstbetitelte Studioalbum Journey To The Source. Fuasi Abdul-Khaliq – Saxophone, Clarinet, Flute Rolf Zielke – Piano Maximilian Hughes – Electric Bass Kenny Martin – Drums

events.description:
A German-French friendship: Bleu Reine hails from the greater Paris area, while Drunk at Your Wedding comes from Berlin. They met in 2024 at a Berlin open mic during Bleu Reine’s last European tour. In 2025, Drunk at Your Wedding got to crash on a couch and perform a living-room concert in Paris. In 2026, the two singer-songwriters are touring Germany together.

Musically, they share a heart rooted in folk and grunge: dark, melodic, and at times volatile. Bleu Reine’s beats hypnotically and layered, interwoven with delicate electronic elements. Songs like shadowy dreamscapes to get lost in. Drunk at Your Wedding sounds more stripped-back and direct. Sometimes loud, sometimes introspective. With a lyrical range spanning everything from musical adaptations of poetry to real-life plane crashes, occasionally even making you laugh.

Paris – Berlin: on the same wavelength, yet operating at different frequencies. Une parfaite liason musicale!

events.description: Lammel | Lauer | Meinig WITH : Andreas Lammel-Florian Lauer-Andris Meinig FEAT : Antonia Hausmann LAMMEL | LAUER | MEINIG haben es früh zu einer ganz eigenen, persönlichen Klangsprache innerhalb der internationalen Jazztrio-Szene und darüber hinaus geschafft. Im Laufe ihrer Bandgeschichte, noch mit Bassisten René Bornstein, veröffentlichten sie unter anderem 3 Alben (Traumton Records) und erhielten viel Lob von allen Seiten, sowie eine Nominierung für den Jazz-Echo . Im Deutschlandfunk Kultur begeisterte sich Jazzredakteur Matthias Wegner für den „ unglaublich schönen Sound “, Concerto erkannte „ hohe intuitive Improvisationskunst .“ Die Fränkische Landeszeitung befand: „ Dieser Jazz hat eine ganz eigene Sprache entwickelt, zeigt sich intelligent, aber nie verkrampft oder kopflastig und zudem ausgesprochen charmant, experimentierfreudig und luftig leicht schwebend .“ In der FAZ schrieb Norbert Krampf über ein Konzert: „ Die Musiker wissen, wie man ein Publikum bei Laune halten kann, ohne in plakatives Entertainment zu verfallen .“ Pünktlich zum Bandjubiläum wagt das Ensemble nun etwas Neues: Nach 15 Jahren, in denen sie ausschließlich im Trio forschten, sich immer wieder neu erfanden und manifestierten, haben sich die drei Herren nun zu einer Erweiterung entschlossen und laden erstmalig besondere Gäste in die Band ein. In der aktuellen Konzertreihe sind sie mit der Leipziger Jazzmusikerin und Posaunistin ANTONIA HAUSMANN unterwegs, die neben ihren eigenen Projekten u.a. mit Clueso, Nina Chuba, Nils Wogram und Kat Frankie musiziert. Mit dem Hamburger Bassisten Andris Meinig hat die Band ein neues Mitglied gewonnen, welches der Band eine unverkennbare Stimme zufügt. Die 4 Künstler*innen loten entschiedener denn je die Spanne zwischen lyrischen Momenten und kraftvoller Wucht aus. Dynamisch und mit viel Gestaltungswillen vereinen sie traumverlorene Melodien und harmonische Vielfalt, ansteckende Grooves und rhythmisch ausgefeilte Strukturen zu einem persönlichen, bewusst verständlich gehaltenen Klang. Wir dürfen uns mit dem neu formierten Ensemble LAMMEL | LAUER | MEINIG featuring ANTONIA HAUSMANN auf ein spannendes akustisch-elektronisches Konzertprogramm freuen! [sign up 19:30 // start 20:00]
CALLING ALL SONGWRITERS, COMPOSERS, INSTRUMENTALISTS, POETS, WRITERS, STORYTELLERS, SYNTH WIZARDS, BAGPIPE SAVANTS, BROKEN HEARTS, TAP DANCERS, POLE DANCERS, MIND MELDERS, RACE CAR DRIVERS, AND AGNOSTIC SAINTS!
Do you have new solo/duo/small group material to present? Join us for Donau115's regular open stage series, Two-Song Tuesday.
Sign-up: 19:30
Set 1: 20:00
Set 2: 21:15
Set 3: 22:15
"The Same Procedure as Every Week, James."
- The random-order setlists appear at 19:45 at http://donau115.de
- First come, first booked, randomly-assigned slot, 15 slots per night + an overflow maybe list that we rarely get to.
- The bar staff tell you how to sign up, starting at 7.30pm. It is usually a link to an online sign-up form.
- Your set may include TWO SONGS or last TEN MINUTES, WHICHEVER IS SHORTER (e.g. two seven-minute songs = NO, three three-minute songs = NO).
- NO SOUNDCHECKS. Be ready. Slip on, blow minds, slip off. Setup is 90 seconds.
- Sets are no longer than 10 minutes. THERE IS A STOPWATCH TO ENSURE THIS. If your set goes beyond 10 minutes, the stopwatch goes off in the middle of your song. (The alarm sound is in the key of C#, FYI, so modulate to that key for a smooth overtime ending.)
- For the love of God, DO NOT PLAY THE SAME SONG OVER AND OVER EVERY WEEK. THIS IS BORING. TRY NEW THINGS. WE ADORE YOU. TAKE RISKS! ❤ ❤ ❤
- Out of respect for our neighbours:
--- you may NOT use loud percussion or send loud bass-heavy signals into the PA.
--- you may NOT bring your own amp
--- you are welcome to use the following itwms from our backline: piano, two generic vocal microphones, and a guitar cable directly into our PA.
--- DON'T COUNT ON US HAVING ANYTHING OTHER THAN THE FEW THINGS LISTED ABOVE. COME PREPARED.
Further questions?
info@donau115.de
